property_summary: The return value of a non-reverting transfer must be true; the mutant returns false even when all external calls succeed.
For any input where the call does not revert, the return value of transfer must be true; the mutant returns false even when all external calls succeed.
For any input where transfer completes without reverting, the return value must be true; the mutant returns false even when all external calls succeed.
For any admissible input where the call does not revert, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false even when all external calls succeed.
For any input where all external calls succeed, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false even when all external calls succeed.
